title: Cost of Running Day Activity Centre Services for Adults with Disabilities
what_it_is: Cost of Running Day Activity Centre Services for Adults with Disabilities

sections.label: Government funding to DACs
sections.summary: Government funding to DACs is tiered by care needs and means-tested by income, averaging about $14,000 per client in FY2022.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Government funding to DACs is tiered according to the care needs of clients.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Government funding to DACs is also means-tested, depending on each client’s income level.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In FY2022, the average amount of Government grants provided to DACs was about $14,000 per client.

sections.label: Costs and funding concerns
sections.summary: Costs can reach about $30,000 yearly, and full means-testing discourages average and higher-income households, so alternate models were suggested.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Although the average grant is about $14,000, some of the costs can go up to about $30,000 per year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: The funding is completely means-tested and, therefore, average and higher-income households are often discouraged from using the services.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: And later on, there will be more costs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: So, the Ministry should really study alternate models, such as providing a universal base subsidy, with additional means-testing subsidy.

sections.label: Fee cap and Enabling Services Hub
sections.summary: The fee cap is between $20 and $710, and this year the Enabling Services Hub will be piloted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: The fee cap is anywhere between $20 and $710.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Of course, there is much more that can be done.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: This year, we will be piloting the Enabling Services Hub.
